fato_historico: 1390: Manuel drives his nephew John VII, who had declared himself emperor in April of that year, out from Constantinople and ends John's reign.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests it is a good time to clear away old burdens and claim your space. Just as history shows that clarity often follows a shift in power, you may find that releasing outdated expectations allows your true spirit to rise. Consider this a fresh start where your adventurous heart leads the way toward unexpected horizons.
frase_do_dia: New beginnings often arise when we let go of what no longer serves us.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of inner wisdom and spiritual potential.
conselho: Trust your intuition and embrace the changes currently unfolding in your life.
